# Ricky Khamis | EPiQ Lending

> Ricky Khamis is President of EPiQ Lending (EVO Home Loans, LLC dba EPiQ Lending, NMLS #1936984), a Certified Mortgage Planner (NMLS #173141), 82nd Airborne veteran, author of Just Win The Day, and host of the Life Mastery Unleashed podcast. Office: 7975 N. Hayden Road, Suite A-101, Scottsdale, AZ 85258. Phone (480) 999-9842. Lending since 1999. Licensed in AZ, CA, CO, FL, NV, TX, UT, IN. Serves Scottsdale, Gilbert, Chandler, Mesa, Phoenix, Paradise Valley, Queen Creek, Tempe and all of Arizona.

## Tools
- [Rate Buydown Calculator](https://rickykhamis.com/buydown-calculator/): Compares 3-2-1, 2-1 and 1-1 temporary buydowns against a 30-year fixed and a permanent buydown funded with the same seller concession. Shows the full payment each year (principal, interest, taxes, insurance, mortgage insurance, HOA), cost of each buydown, cash to close, and the month a permanent buydown passes a temporary one. Builds a shareable presentation link and PDF.
- [Cash-Out Refinance Calculator](https://rickykhamis.com/cash-out-refinance-calculator/): Enter every loan secured by the home and every debt to be paid off, each with its balance, rate and payment. Returns the balance-weighted blended rate being carried today, the new loan amount and loan-to-value, and the new payment priced at the latest Freddie Mac Primary Mortgage Market Survey 30-year average, which the page refreshes daily and shows dated. Also shows total interest on the current path against the new loan, the payoff horizon being restarted, and what happens if the borrower keeps paying the old total after refinancing. Flags cash-out LTV limits, debts whose payment does not cover their interest, and the fact that consolidating unsecured debt secures it against the home.
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://rickykhamis.com/calculator/)

## For Realtor Partners
- [The 2-24-48 Mortgage Standard](https://rickykhamis.com/perfectloanprocess/): The service standard EPiQ Lending runs for Realtor partners, named for its three clocks: credit reviewed within 2 hours of application, a signed AAR Pre-Qualification Form in the agent’s hands within 24 hours, and the buyer consultation booked within 48. From there, a Loan Status Update every Tuesday at 9am with the signed AAR LSU attached, a same-day update at every milestone, and a fixed rule for who hears what when the appraisal lands. Every promise has a time on it.

## Topic guides

- [Physician and medical professional home loans](https://rickykhamis.com/physician-home-loans/): Everything a physician, dentist, veterinarian, pharmacist, CRNA or nurse practitioner needs to know about doctor loan programs in Arizona. Eligibility, leverage, student loan treatment, employment contracts, reserves and the rules that decide your file.
- [Self-employed and business owner home loans](https://rickykhamis.com/self-employed-home-loans/): Bank statement loans, third-party P&L documentation, written verification of employment and streamline documentation, explained from the guidelines. The expense factor table, co-mingling, large deposits, business age and the tier rules that decide which options you get.
- [DSCR and investor property loans](https://rickykhamis.com/dscr-investor-loans/): DSCR loans qualify the property rather than the borrower. The calculation, the leverage grid, No Ratio structures, LLC vesting, cash-out seasoning, short-term rentals, multi-unit caps and how to sequence a portfolio so the fourth loan still closes.
- [Asset based and no-income home loans](https://rickykhamis.com/asset-based-home-loans/): Asset depletion and asset qualifier programs convert a portfolio into qualifying income without selling anything. The haircut schedule, the 84 month divisor, the residual income test, trust and crypto treatment, and the five things these loans will not do.

## Articles
- [Veterinarian Home Loans: Why DVM Borrowers Qualify Under Physician Programs](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/veterinarian-home-loans-dvm/): DVM and VMD are named on the physician program designation list. The problem for veterinarians is never eligibility, it is the debt-to-income ceiling, and there is a specific structural trade that buys five points of it back.
- [Trusts, Inherited Assets and Crypto: Which Holdings a Lender Will Actually Count](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/trust-and-inherited-assets-mortgage/): Trust assets have to meet agency guidelines, cryptocurrency counts at sixty percent from one named source, and there is a provision for buying siblings out of an inherited house that waives seasoning entirely.
- [Self-Employed Jumbo Loans: Buying Above Conforming Without Tax Returns](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/self-employed-jumbo-loans/): Non-QM jumbo runs to three and a half million dollars on bank statements, with no mortgage insurance at any leverage. The constraint is rarely the loan size. It is the ratio ceiling and the reserve requirement that come with it.
- [Self-Employed Home Loan FAQ: What Actually Qualifies a Business Owner](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/self-employed-home-loan-faq/): Every question a self-employed borrower asks, answered from the guidelines. Documentation routes, the expense factor table, ownership rules, co-mingling, large deposits, business age and the three things that make a file ineligible outright.
- [Self-Employed Cash-Out Refinance: Pulling Equity Without Two Years of Returns](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/self-employed-cash-out-refinance/): Cash-out limits on these programs are set by your leverage, not by a flat cap, and at or below sixty percent loan-to-value they disappear entirely. Here is the full structure, tier by tier.
- [The Second-Year Attending: What Changes When Your Contract Income Becomes History](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/second-year-attending-mortgage/): In year one your income is a contract and your student loans may be invisible. In year two the contract is a tax return and the student loan payment is real. Most physicians buy at the top of year one and discover the difference in year three.
- [Retired With No Paycheck: The Three Ways a Lender Can Build You an Income](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/retiree-mortgage-no-paycheck/): Three different calculations can produce your qualifying income as a retiree and they give very different answers. Most lenders run one, quote you the weakest, and never mention the other two.
- [Restaurant and Hospitality Owners: Why Your Deposits Qualify You for Less](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/restaurant-hospitality-owner-mortgage/): Restaurants sit in the worst cell of the expense factor table. An owner with employees keeps fifteen percent of deposits as qualifying income under the fixed formula, and there are two documented routes out of that cell.
- [The Double Count Problem: Why Money Used for Closing Cannot Also Be Income](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/reserves-vs-depletion-double-count/): One sentence in the guidelines removes your down payment from the portfolio before the income calculation runs. Understanding it changes which account you should pull closing funds from, and it is worth thousands a month in qualifying income.
- [Under Two Years Self-Employed: What You Can and Cannot Do Yet](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/recently-self-employed-mortgage/): Two years of business existence is the standard requirement, and there is a written exception that reaches back to one year for licensed professionals. Here is the exception, who it covers, and what to do if it does not cover you.
- [Realtors and Commission-Only Income: Qualifying When Your Pay Is Lumpy](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/realtor-commission-income-mortgage/): There is a rule that closes the bank statement route to most agents and almost nobody mentions it: borrowers paid 1099 from a single company are not eligible for bank statement qualification. How you are paid decides which door you walk through.
- [After the Business Sale: Buying a Home in the Year You Have No Income](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/post-liquidity-event-mortgage/): You sold the company and your qualifying income went to zero in the same week your net worth went up. Sale proceeds count toward asset based qualification, with specific documentation, and there are three exclusions that catch sellers.
- [Physician Loans Near Banner, Mayo and HonorHealth: Buying in Phoenix, Chandler and Gilbert](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/physician-loans-phoenix-chandler-gilbert/): Where you work in the Valley changes the commute, the price point and frequently the loan structure. A guide to buying as a physician around the major Phoenix metro health systems, with the program rules that apply to each situation.
- [Physician Loan or Conventional: Which One Is Actually Cheaper on Your File](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/physician-loan-vs-conventional/): No mortgage insurance sounds like the cheaper loan and frequently is not. There is also a rule most lenders never mention: the physician program has a minimum loan-to-value, so a borrower with 20% saved is not eligible for it at all.
- [Physician Loan Reserves: The Requirement That Quietly Decides Your Price Range](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/physician-loan-reserves-requirements/): Reserves are the requirement physicians discover last and plan for least. They scale with leverage, they scale with loan size, they scale with every other property you own, and closing before a start date adds a month for every month you are early.
- [Refinancing a Physician Loan: When to Leave It Alone and When to Move](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/physician-loan-refinance/): Physician programs are purchase and rate-and-term only, so the loan that got you in cannot hand you cash later. There is also a recast option most physicians never hear about, which solves the signing bonus problem without a refinance at all.
- [Nine Ways Physicians Lose the House: Mistakes That Kill a Doctor Loan](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/physician-loan-mistakes/): Almost every physician loan that falls apart fails for one of nine reasons, and eight of them are visible weeks before closing. Here is the list, with the guideline behind each one.
- [Physician Loan Down Payment: What 0%, 5% and 10% Actually Cost You](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/physician-loan-down-payment-options/): Zero down is the headline and it is frequently the wrong choice. Moving from 100% to 95% financing raises the debt-to-income ceiling by five points and cuts the reserve requirement, and there is a floor below which the program will not take you at all.
- [Physician Loan Credit Scores: What 680, 700 and 720 Each Unlock](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/physician-loan-credit-score-requirements/): Two points of credit score can be worth five hundred thousand dollars of loan amount on a physician program. Here are the exact thresholds, the four year seasoning rule on derogatory events, and the inquiry rule that catches physicians who furnish a house before closing.
- [Buying Before Your Start Date: The Contract and Reserve Rules for Physicians](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/physician-loan-before-start-date/): You can close on a house before you have earned a dollar at the new job. The contract has to say five specific things, the start date has a hard outside limit, and every month between closing and day one costs you a month of reserves.
- [Physician Jumbo Loans to $2,000,000: Where the Leverage Stops and Why](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/physician-jumbo-loans-arizona/): A physician can borrow two million dollars with nothing down, at a 720 score, on a one unit primary residence. Above that the program ends. Here is the full ceiling, the adjustable structure that reaches it differently, and the acreage rule that catches north Scottsdale buyers.
- [Physician Home Loan FAQ: Straight Answers to the Thirty Questions Doctors Actually Ask](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/physician-home-loan-faq/): Every question a physician asks about doctor loans, answered from the guidelines rather than from marketing. Eligibility, leverage, student loans, contracts, reserves, credit, property rules and what the programs will not do.
- [Pharmacist Home Loans: What PharmD Borrowers Get and Where the Programs Stop](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/pharmacist-home-loans-pharmd/): PharmD is named on the physician program designation list, which surprises most pharmacists and most loan officers. Here is what the program gives a pharmacist, and the two places it stops short.
- [No-Ratio DSCR Loans: Financing a Property That Does Not Cover Its Payment](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/no-ratio-dscr-loans/): When the rent will not clear even 0.75x, there is a structure that stops calculating the ratio altogether. It costs leverage, it removes interest only entirely, and it is the right answer more often than people think.
- [Large Deposits, Transfers and NSFs: What an Underwriter Does With Your Statements](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/large-deposits-nsf-bank-statements/): Underwriters do not just total your deposits. They exclude some, question others, read the outflows, and count overdrafts against a hard limit. Here is every rule that runs across your bank statements, and what to prepare before you send them.
- [How to Calculate DSCR Yourself Before You Write the Offer](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/how-to-calculate-dscr/): The formula is one line. Everything that makes it hard is on the bottom, where taxes, insurance, association dues and rent loss coverage live. Here is how to run it accurately on an Arizona property in ten minutes.
- [One Late Payment: How Housing History Moves You Between Non-QM Tiers](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/housing-history-tiers-non-qm/): Your documentation options are not chosen by you. They are assigned by your housing event history and mortgage lates, and a single 30 day late can remove the P&L and asset routes from the table entirely.
- [First-Time Investors on DSCR: The Three Conditions That Get You In](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/first-time-investor-dscr/): The program is written for professional investors with twelve months of experience. There is an exception for your first property, it has exactly three conditions, and one of them disqualifies anyone who does not already own a home.
- [The Expense Factor Table: Why Your Industry Decides Your Qualifying Income](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/expense-factor-by-business-type/): Two businesses with identical deposits can be handed qualifying income that differs by a factor of five, decided entirely by what the business sells and how many people it employs. Here is the whole table and the three ways to get out from under it.
- [DSCR or Conventional Investment Financing: Which One Your Fifth Property Needs](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/dscr-vs-conventional-investment/): Conventional investment lending is usually cheaper and it stops working at a predictable point. Knowing where that point is, and structuring the transition before you hit it, is what separates investors who reach ten properties from those who stall at four.
- [DSCR Loan FAQ: The Questions Investors Ask Before Their First One](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/dscr-loan-faq/): Everything a DSCR borrower needs answered, from the guidelines. The calculation, the leverage grid, reserves, LLC vesting, cash-out, first-time investors, rent loss insurance and the requirements that surprise people at closing.
- [Closing a DSCR Loan in an LLC: The Vesting Rules and What They Cost You](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/dscr-llc-vesting/): Title can be held in an LLC, but the application is in your name, you sign personally and as an authorized signor, and a personal guaranty is required. Here is every condition the entity has to satisfy, and the one that quietly limits your partnership.
- [DSCR Credit, Reserves and Rent Loss Insurance: The Requirements Nobody Mentions First](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/dscr-credit-reserves-requirements/): A DSCR file is sold on what it does not require. Here is what it does: a clean twelve months, three years since any housing event, reserves by loan size, rent loss coverage, a personal guaranty and a check on the home you live in.
- [DSCR Cash-Out Refinance: Seasoning, Business Purpose and the Affidavit You Sign](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/dscr-cash-out-refinance/): Six months of ownership, business purpose only, a letter explaining the use of proceeds, and an affidavit you sign at closing. Take the money for personal use and the loan is not eligible for the program at all.
- [DSCR on Duplexes, Triplexes and Fourplexes: How the Ratio Changes With Unit Count](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/dscr-2-4-unit-properties/): Multi-unit properties are capped at 75% leverage on DSCR regardless of how strong the coverage is. In exchange you get a rent roll that does not go to zero when one tenant leaves, which is a better trade than most investors realise.
- [Dentist Home Loans: How DDS and DMD Borrowers Buy Before the Practice Is Established](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/dentist-home-loans-dds-dmd/): DDS and DMD are on the eligible designation list, but the student loan exclusion that carries medical residents usually does not apply to dentists. If you are paid on a 1099 as an associate, a second set of rules decides your file.
- [CRNA and Nurse Practitioner Home Loans: The Designation Rules That Decide Your File](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/crna-nurse-practitioner-home-loans/): CRNAs and Nurse Practitioners are on the physician program designation list, but both carry a degree condition attached to the title. Your credential, not your job, decides whether you are eligible.
- [Write-Offs and Qualifying Income: The Trade Every Business Owner Makes Without Knowing](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/business-owner-write-offs-mortgage/): Every deduction that lowers your tax bill lowers the income a lender will use, dollar for dollar, on a full documentation loan. Some of those deductions come back on other routes and some do not. Here is which is which.
- [Building a Rental Portfolio on DSCR: Sequencing Loans So the Fourth One Still Closes](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/building-a-rental-portfolio-dscr/): One rule makes serial acquisition possible on this program and one set of caps decides the order you should buy in. Here is how to sequence a portfolio so the constraint that stops most investors never arrives.
- [Asset Depletion or Asset Qualifier: Two Programs, Two Completely Different Tests](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/asset-depletion-vs-asset-qualifier/): They use the same 84 month divisor and the same haircut schedule, then test entirely different things. One runs a debt-to-income ratio, the other runs residual income. Which one you need depends on how much monthly debt you carry.
- [Asset Based Home Loan FAQ: Qualifying With Assets Instead of Income](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/asset-based-home-loan-faq/): Everything a borrower with a portfolio and no paycheck needs answered. The two programs, the haircut schedule, the minimums, what is excluded, and the five things these loans will not do.
- [12 or 24 Months of Bank Statements: Which Period Qualifies You for More](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/12-vs-24-month-bank-statements/): The choice is not about how much paperwork you feel like gathering. There is a rule that quietly overrides your 24 month average when income is declining, and it means the two options are not symmetrical.
- [1099 and Locum Tenens Physicians: Qualifying When You Are Paid as a Contractor](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/1099-locum-tenens-physician-loans/): Contractor physicians run under a separate rule set with a 60 day start date window, a required no-expenses confirmation, and one line that moves you out of the physician program entirely if you filed 1099 income last year.
- [1099 Contractors and Gig Income: The Documentation Routes That Actually Work](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/1099-contractor-gig-mortgage/): Being paid on a 1099 by one company closes the bank statement route entirely. Being paid by several opens it, with conditions. Here is which rulebook applies to your situation and what each one costs.
- [Zero Down Without Being a Veteran: How the VA Alternative Works for Arizona Buyers](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/va-alternative-zero-down-arizona/): The VA Alternative pairs an FHA loan with approved down payment assistance so a qualified non-veteran can buy an Arizona primary residence with no down payment. Here is how it works, what it actually costs, and who should slow down before using it.
- [Short-Term Rental DSCR Loans in Scottsdale: Qualifying an Airbnb on Its Nightly Income](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/short-term-rental-dscr-scottsdale/): Short-term rental income can qualify a Scottsdale investment property on a DSCR loan, but the leverage is capped at 70% and the coverage floor rises to 1.00x. Refinances need a full 12-month income history from the platform. Here is how it is documented.
- [RSU and Equity Comp and Buying in McDowell Mountain Ranch, Scottsdale: How You Actually Qualify](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/rsu-mcdowell-mountain-ranch-scottsdale/): Vested stock that already ran through your W-2 usually counts. Unvested shares generally do not. In a community that draws tech and finance buyers, the vesting schedule is the document nobody brings and everybody needs.
- [12-Month P&amp;L Loans and Written Verification of Employment: Qualifying Without Tax Returns or Bank Statements](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/profit-and-loss-wvoe-loans-self-employed/): If your bank statements understate the business and your tax returns understate your income, a third-party prepared profit and loss statement can qualify you instead. Here is what validates a P&L, who can prepare it, and where WVOE fits.
- [Personal or Business Bank Statements: Which One Qualifies a Self-Employed Borrower for More](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/personal-vs-business-bank-statements/): Choosing between personal and business bank statements is not a filing preference. It changes whether the expense factor applies to you at all, and co-mingling your accounts can force you into the option that qualifies you for less.
- [Non-Warrantable Condo Financing in Scottsdale: Why the Building Gets Declined and How the Loan Still Closes](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/non-warrantable-condo-financing-scottsdale/): When a Scottsdale condo is declined, it is usually the project that failed, not the buyer. Commercial space share, investor concentration and pending litigation are the usual causes, and a non-warrantable program can finance all three.
- [Medical Residents and Fellows: How Student Loan Payments Are Excluded From Your Mortgage Qualification](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/medical-residents-student-loans-mortgage/): A resident with $300,000 in student debt can be approved because physician programs exclude deferred, forbearance and income-based repayment student loan payments from the ratio, but only while you are in residency or a clinical fellowship. Here are the exact conditions.
- [Investor Buying at the Scottsdale Waterfront: How You Actually Qualify](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/investor-scottsdale-waterfront/): High-rise condo financing where the project is approved or denied before you are. Owner-occupancy ratios, commercial square footage and condotel classification decide Waterfront deals, not your credit score.
- [Home Loans for Lawyers, Engineers, Architects and CPAs: The Graduate Degree Programs Nobody Tells You About](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/graduate-professional-home-loans-scottsdale/): Physician loan programs exclude most professionals. A separate graduate program finances up to 90% with no mortgage insurance for Masters and post-graduate degrees in law, engineering, architecture and accounting, and qualifies you on a signed contract.
- [DSCR Loans in Scottsdale: How Investors Qualify on the Rent Instead of Their Tax Returns](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/dscr-loans-scottsdale-investors/): A DSCR loan ignores your personal income entirely and qualifies the property on its own rent against its own payment. Coverage as low as 0.75x is eligible on some programs, and no-ratio options exist. Here is the calculation and the rules that decide the file.
- [Asset Depletion and Asset Qualifier Loans: How a Portfolio Becomes Qualifying Income](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/asset-depletion-asset-qualifier-loans/): Asset based programs convert liquid assets into qualifying income by dividing them over 84 months, but not every dollar counts at face value. Retirement accounts count at 70%, stocks at 80%, crypto at 60%. Here is the full haircut schedule and the thresholds.
- [Physician Home Loans in Scottsdale: How Doctors Buy With No Down Payment and No Mortgage Insurance](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/physician-home-loans-scottsdale/): Physician loan programs finance up to 100% of a Scottsdale primary residence with no mortgage insurance at any loan-to-value, and they let you qualify on a signed employment contract before you have drawn a single paycheck. Here is who qualifies and where the limits actually sit.
- [Bank Statement Loans: How Lenders Actually Turn Your Deposits Into Qualifying Income](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/bank-statement-loans-how-income-is-calculated/): A bank statement loan does not count your deposits as income. It applies an expense factor set by your industry and your employee count, and that single number can swing your qualifying income by tens of thousands a year. Here is the table and how to read it.
- [Buying a Second Home in Kierland, Scottsdale: How You Actually Qualify](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/second-home-kierland-scottsdale/): Kierland is walkable luxury next to the Quarter and Commons, heavy on condos and second homes. That mix decides both your occupancy classification and whether the building passes project review at all.
- [Retired and Buying in Legend Trail, Scottsdale: How You Actually Qualify](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/retiree-legend-trail-scottsdale/): Three different calculations can produce your qualifying income as a retiree, and they give very different answers. Most lenders run one and quote you the weakest. Here is how all three work in north Scottsdale.
- [Self-Employed and Buying in Ancala, Scottsdale: How You Actually Qualify](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/self-employed-ancala-scottsdale/): Ancala sits against the McDowell Mountains in east Scottsdale, a private country club community where the HOA and club stack surprises buyers at underwriting. Here is the whole calculation before you write.
- [Investor Buying Near Talking Stick, Scottsdale: How You Actually Qualify](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/investor-talking-stick-scottsdale/): Talking Stick sits beside the entertainment corridor, which is exactly where short-term rental income questions start. Here is what a lender will actually count, and the land status question unique to this corner of Scottsdale.
- [Self-Employed and Buying in McCormick Ranch, Scottsdale: How You Actually Qualify](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/self-employed-mccormick-ranch-scottsdale/): McCormick Ranch straddles the conforming loan limit. For a self-employed buyer that single line decides your reserve requirement, your ratio tolerance and how much documentation you face, and your tax return decides which side you land on.
- [After a Liquidity Event, Buying in Desert Highlands, Scottsdale: How You Actually Qualify](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/liquidity-event-desert-highlands-scottsdale/): You sold the company and on a mortgage application you look unemployed. Desert Highlands is one of Scottsdale's original Nicklaus communities, and the structure that finances it is built on your balance sheet, not your income.
- [Asset Depletion and Buying in Mirabel, Scottsdale: How You Actually Qualify](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/asset-depletion-mirabel-scottsdale/): Mirabel sits at nearly 3,000 feet in far north Scottsdale, where homes transact infrequently and the comparable sales get thin. On an asset-based file, the appraisal is the risk, not your balance sheet.
- [Self-Employed and Buying in Whisper Rock, Scottsdale: How You Actually Qualify](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/self-employed-whisper-rock-scottsdale/): At Whisper Rock, owning a home does not give you membership rights to the club. That single fact changes how an underwriter treats the dues, and it works in your favor more often than buyers expect.
- [Things to Do in Old Town Scottsdale: Art, Museums, Shopping and the Thursday ArtWalk](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/things-to-do-old-town-scottsdale/): Two art museums, the oldest weekly art walk in the country, 250 retailers under one roof, and Arizona wine poured a few blocks from all of it. - [Golf Near Old Town Scottsdale: What You Can Reach Without a Car](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/golf-near-old-town-scottsdale/): Scottsdale's golf reputation was built in the north, but there are courses a mile from Old Town, including the oldest in the city. Here is what is actually close, and what a club obligation does to a loan.
- [Where to Stay in Old Town Scottsdale: The Walkable Hotels](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/old-town-scottsdale-hotels/): Old Town hotels let you leave the car keys at the front desk, which North Scottsdale resorts cannot. Here are the walkable stays, what each one is actually for, and the classification question that decides how they finance.
- [Old Town Scottsdale Nightlife: The Entertainment District, Rooftops, and Where the Noise Actually Is](https://rickykhamis.com/blog/old-town-scottsdale-nightlife/): More than 100 bars, clubs and restaurants in a walkable footprint around Camelback and Saddlebag Trail.
